footer.claim: More strength. More mobility. More life.

home.heroTitle: Strength, movement and wellbeing to live better
home.heroClaim: Getting older does not mean stopping training. It means training better.
home.aboutTitle: Specialists in strength, mobility and longevity from age 50
home.aboutP1: BONAFIT is not a conventional gym or a generic workout. We support people — especially from age 50 — who want to stay active, strong, agile and independent.
home.aboutP2: We train movement and wellbeing with calm, precision and respect for your body. The aim is not to fit a mould: it is for everyday life to feel lighter.
home.quote: “We do not train so you can be 50. We train so you can live your 70s with strength.”
home.slogan: Age is not trained. Strength is.
home.offerLede: Close support at home in the Bonalba area and, later on, in a small private studio.
home.complementsText: To look after tone, recovery and a sense of wellbeing between sessions.
home.longevityTitle: We do not sell hours. We look after the life you want to keep living.
home.longevityText: The value of a BONAFIT programme is not measured in sets or minutes. It is measured in autonomy, confidence and the freedom to move without age becoming a barrier.
home.longevitySlogan: More strength. More mobility. More life.
home.areaTitle: Near you, in a setting that invites you to look after your body
home.areaLede: We work mainly in the Bonalba urbanisation and surroundings, and can travel to nearby towns.

offers.title: Personalised sessions
offers.text: Workouts of about 55–60 minutes, designed for you. We recommend two sessions a week to progress steadily, without rushing.

offers.title: Assessment and programme
offers.text: We start with an initial assessment, listen to your goals and design an individual programme that evolves with you.

offers.title: A body that supports you
offers.text: We work on strength, mobility, balance and functional movement, with close follow-up so every session has a purpose.

outcomes: More confidence walking and climbing stairs
Standing up from a chair independently
Travelling and moving without age as a limit
Playing with grandchildren and enjoying the day
Strength, mobility and confidence to live better
